dependency_edges.handoff: workflow sends task boundaries to assumptions
official uncertainty and information tasks define telemetry needs
shape, buoyancy, and failure premises constrain dynamics
sensor and telemetry outputs enter state estimation
force dynamics supply the filter prediction model
filtered state and covariance produce trajectory and probability
state mean and covariance define feasible zone
trajectory and dispersion outputs enter search
filter noise and covariance require regional recalibration
single-target search is reused in neighbor response
